doc: docs/EMBEDDING.md §6: the files an embedder of the qed64 package needs. embed = the TypeScript closure of the `qed64/embed` entry (relative imports only); workers = plain scripts served at serveAs (lean.worker.js importScripts lsp-frames.js and lsp-front-door.js from its own directory); pipeline = the from-source lane scripts (relative and node: imports only); pipelineData = files the pipeline reads at run time, at the same relative paths.

runtime.note: the oldest kernel patch level whose runtime these workers drive correctly (the resident header resolver and $/qed64/headerStatus, patch 0032), not what QED64 serves; compare against your own KERNEL-PIN

workerProtocol.note: docs/EMBEDDING.md §7.7: the three worker scripts carry `revision` and refuse a sibling of another one (WORKER_DEP_MISMATCH); `requests` is what capabilities().requests reports; a removal is listed under deprecated with the release it went unused in, and leaves the worker one release later
